name: dumbbell one arm press on exercise ball
description: A single-arm dumbbell press lying with your upper back on a stability ball. Balance and core control are part of every rep.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a dumbbell, then walk your feet forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Lift your hips so your body is level from knees to shoulders.
Hold the dumbbell beside your chest with your elbow bent.
Press it straight up until your arm is extended.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
